### workspace relaunch --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace relaunch [--json]

Stop all active workspace projects and relaunch them.

        --json                       Print one action document (see docs/README.json.md) instead of progress text;
                                     the text goes to stderr. Exit 0, 3 when some projects failed, 1 when all did

Examples:
  workspace relaunch    # stop every active project and relaunch it (headless ones stay headless)
  workspace relaunch --json    # a script relaunching everything and checking the result
  workspace relaunch --json 2>/dev/null    # keep the progress text out of the way when piping the document
--- stderr
--- end
